title: Implement QQ16 finite-schema adoption updates with alias preservation
body:
## Summary

```text
literal PR4167 adoption + PR4790 cached inventories
  -> stable finite record addresses
  -> fresh source tuples and ordered cache replacement
  -> paid inventory projection, mark/sweep and disposal
```

Implement the adoption portion of the missing QQ16 source frontend. Prove that opaque numerical leaf values can be omitted while preserving ordered Tape DFS. Preserve tuple identity and retained aliases: in-place tuple rewriting can otherwise conceal a Tape that is still owned by the caller.

This is a partial `F_adopt(L,N,V)` metadata implementation with an explicit constructor/transient schema capacity L. Source constructor/schema generation, Context/recipe/Ordinary mutations and physical marker/body actions remain outside the implementation. It does not establish the complete F(K), a matched caller advantage or a new kappa.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR4986 consumes host-encoded graphs; PR5034 bounds return-cut shape but provides no adoption store update.
  **After:** Literal retained `adopt_return` and unchanged `ReturnProtocol` agree with finite-store updates on 16 transactions covering producer/service and bank/private branches. Four further transactions with `10**100000` have identical encoding and invoice. Both source and finite inventory reject a retained-old-tuple Tape alias.
- Registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized replay pass, along with metadata/source pins. The test uses an explicit role schema and marker-only Tape oracle; it does not rerun the predecessor 49-validation/36-exchange controller case.
- Original caller/adoption sources remain unchanged. Chris R/Clear1nsight, Tekalign, Jose Manuel, Mihir Srivastava, ywz65 and the retained physical/control lineage keep their credit; new work by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

Only a new scoped research package. No selected-frontier change or supplier admission; the remaining source mutation obligations are enumerated in PROOF.md.

## Task, overlap and remaining work

Task `b2_qq16_finite_source_frontend` / `joint-query-controller`; [canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4744#discussioncomment-19140805). Scientific base `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`, priority revision 7. The delivered scope is explicitly narrower than the original complete-adapter objective; the README and PROOF record the unimplemented obligations and Open next questions.

Pre-submission checkpoint: canonical main `ff3cc58e3` was fetched on 2026-10-23; governing guidance and selected record are unchanged. Fresh advisory overlap covered 371 open PRs and 4587 discussion records with complete reported pagination; no competing implementation of this precise scoped result was found. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain outside this coverage. Official metadata, committed-byte/source-history, package export/check and optimized Git-free replay pass. A separate Astra source/proof review found no remaining actionable issue at the submitted head. This is scoped AI-assisted evidence, not human/proof-kernel acceptance.
